title: admin endpoint missing connection/request size limits (slowloris vector)
description: Both transit/src/admin.rs and reader/src/admin.rs implement a hand-rolled HTTP/1.1 parser using read_line in a loop with no read deadline, no maximum header count, and no maximum header line length. A client that connects and drips bytes one per second will hold the connection open indefinitely, consuming a task and a file descriptor. There is no accept-backlog limit or connection count cap on the admin port. On a loopback-only deployment this is low severity, but if admin.addr is set to a non-loopback address this becomes a trivial denial-of-service vector. Maintenance consequence: any contributor adding an admin endpoint will inherit this handrolled HTTP parser pattern without recognising the missing defenses.
